descriptions.description: Loeflingia is a genus of plant in the family Caryophyllaceae occurring in North America, Europe, northern Africa, and southwestern Asia. Plants of the genus bear bristle-like stipules, as well as axillary, sessile flowers with awned sepals and no or vestigial petals. The fruit is a three-valved capsule.
Species include the following: Loeflingia baetica Lag. Loeflingia hispanica L. Loeflingia squarrosa Nutt. Loeflingia tavaresiana Samp.
